description: Utility class for formatting DateTime objects into string representations using the intl package.

classes.name: DateTimeUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to format DateTime objects into localized date and date-time strings.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a string with the year, month, and day. Returns '-' if input is null.

methods.name: formatDateTime
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a string with date and time components. Returns '-' if input is null.
